# SPEC — Support Ticket Triage Assistant

## Goal
Route inbound support tickets to the right queue and draft a first reply, so
the two-person support team stops hand-sorting ~400 tickets a week.

## Approach
An LLM classifies each ticket into one of six queues (billing, onboarding,
bug, feature-request, abuse, other) and writes a suggested reply. We call
`gpt-4o-mini` through the existing gateway. Temperature 0.7 for the reply,
same call for the classification.

## Data
Tickets come from the Zendesk webhook. We pass the subject and the full body
of the ticket, plus the customer's plan tier, into the prompt.

## Interface
`POST /triage` with `{ticket_id}`. Returns `{queue, draft_reply, confidence}`.
`confidence` is whatever number the model puts in its JSON output.

## Rollout
Week 1: shadow mode, log the output. Week 2: show the draft in the agent
console. Week 3: auto-send drafts for the billing queue.

## Success
Support lead reviews a handful of outputs at the end of week 1 and says
whether it feels right. If it does, we move to week 2.

## Out of scope
Multilingual tickets, attachments, voice.
